title: APCC-2021-7874-SPE-ZAA-ZAD-SPP-DRB
text:
APCC-2021-7874-SPE-ZAA-ZAD-SPP-DRB  Council District: 4 – Raman
  CEQA: ENV-2021-7875-CE  Last Day to Act: 08-19-26
  Plan Area: Hollywood

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  6023 West Rodgerton Drive

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Construction of a three-story single-family dwelling with a Residential Floor Area of 3,089 square-feet, on
  a 12,066 square foot lot. The dwelling will have a height of 43'-6". Five parking spaces will be provided.
  Three retaining walls are proposed, with a maximum height of 10 feet. Regarding grading, the Project
  proposes 1,450 cubic yards of cut, 570 cubic yards of fill, and 980 cubic yards of export in total. The Project
  does not propose the removal of any trees, and there are no protected trees or shrubs on-site.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15303, Class 3, an
  Exemption from CEQA, and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 11.5.7 F. of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Specific Plan
  Exception to permit the location of retaining walls within three feet of the front lot line, as otherwise
  prohibited per Section 7.B.1 of the Hollywoodland Specific Plan;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.28, a Zoning Administrator's Adjustment to permit retaining
  walls with a maximum height of 10 feet located within the required front and side yards, in lieu of the
  three and one-half foot limitation in the front yard and the six foot limitation in the side yard per LAMC
  Chapter 1 Section 12.22 C.20.(f).
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.26, a Zoning Administrator's Determination to permit
  three retaining walls with a maximum height of 10 feet, in lieu of the limitation of one retaining wall with
  a maximum height of 12 feet per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.8.(a);
  5. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28, a Zoning Administrator's Determination to permit the
  construction of a new single-family dwelling fronting on a Substandard Hillside Limited Street without
  providing a 20-foot-wide continuous paved roadway from the driveway apron to the boundary of the
  Hillside Area as otherwise required per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10.(i)(3);
  6. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Sections 11.5.7. C. and 16.50, and Section 9 of the Hollywoodland
  Specific Plan (Ordinance No. 168,121), a Project Permit Compliance Review and Design Review for
  the construction of a new single-family dwelling in the RE9-1-HCR Zone;

  Applicant:  Sarkis Mkhitarian
  Representative: Jeff Allen, Pacific Crest Consultants

  Staff:  Valentina Knox-Jones, City Planner
  valentina.knox.jones@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1741
summary: Proposed construction of a three-story single-family dwelling on a hillside lot in Hollywood requiring multiple zoning adjustments and specific plan exceptions.
